name: 434133025816 WS-TASV tactile switch SMD-4P 4.2x3.2mm C5504987
source: JLCPCB parts library page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C5504987 read 2026-11-10 (Wurth Elektronik 434133025816, package SMD-4P 4.2x3.2mm, library type Extended) ; datasheet: https://www.we-online.com/components/products/datasheet/434133025816.pdf (Wurth Elektronik 434133025816, WS-TASV J-Bend SMT Tact Switch, REVISION 001.001 of 2021-01-25, 7 pages, read 2026-11-10) ; rated_current, rated_voltage: Electrical Properties table, page 2, 'Rated Current IR' 50 mA and 'Rated Voltage VR' 16 V (DC) ; height: page 1, Properties table, H = 2.5 mm, and the side view 2.5 +0.2/-0.1, so 2.7 mm at most ; temp_min, temp_max: General Information, page 2, 'Operating Temperature' -40 up to +85 C (the document does not say ambient)
notes: Wurth Elektronik. WS-TASV J-bend tactile switch, 4.2 x 3.2 mm, 160 gf (operation force 160 g +/-50 g, page 2), 100000 cycles at 50 mA / 16 V DC. The circuit is page 1's schematic: terminals 1 and 2 are joined, 3 and 4 are joined, and the button joins the two pairs; std Switch has two pads and cannot be this part, so the project's TactileSwitch has one pin for each pair (src/tactile_switch.nsm). JLCPCB lists SPST-NO, 1.6 N, 100000 cycles, 16 V, 50 mA, height 2.5 mm.
